author: Zintenka
body:
I and many other mapmakers cannot wait for this update to come forth... perhaps an ETA could be given? Will it come out in a few weeks or a month?

Also..



YOU ACTUALLY IMPLEMENTED THESE THINGS I SUGGESTED!? WOW! I'M SO HAPPY!

Can't. Wait. Hype. So. High. HNNNGGGGGGGHHH!

Mistakes:



You duplicated two components, there is supposed to be only one like so.

<monuments materials="obsidian">
     <monument name="Core" owner="red">
          <region><point>-32,21,-50</point></region>
     </monument>
</monuments>



Same outcome here as well.

You also made the same mistake inside the example XML and you also forgot the <objectives></objectives> thingy.

replies.body:
There's no errors there, just opening and closing tags.

<monument> tags simply inherit attributes from parent <monuments>.

Edit: The wools tag could be prettier by remove the one parent <wools>, not sure why I put it there. But it still works!
